name: flycommerce
description: FlyCommerce plugins for Claude Code: apps, the store API, the store MCP server and the UI library.

plugins.name: flycommerce-apps
plugins.description: Build FlyCommerce apps that merchants install: installs, session tokens, dashboard pages, storefront scripts with cart actions and shopper tokens, store API calls, webhooks, private and listed apps, and developing and releasing with the flycommerce CLI. Brings in flycommerce-api and flycommerce-ui.

plugins.name: flycommerce-api
plugins.description: Call a FlyCommerce store's REST API from an app or a script: tokens, finding endpoints, filters, paging, sync, errors and webhooks.

plugins.name: flycommerce-mcp
plugins.description: Connect an AI agent or agent platform to a FlyCommerce store's MCP server: tools, identity, checkout hand-off and errors.

plugins.name: flycommerce-ui
plugins.description: Build FlyCommerce screens with the @flycommerce/ui design system: components, tokens, icons and screen recipes.
